replacement_claim: Countdown timing: on request acceptance load cnt_reg=TIMEOUT_CYCLES-1, then decrement on each busy cycle without ack and assert timeout when cnt_reg==1. This makes the acceptance edge count as the first timeout cycle.
rationale: Inject an off-by-one interpretation that incorrectly counts the idle request-acceptance edge as one of the allowed busy service edges, and pair it with RTL that implements the same timing rule.
